title: check-prior-rulings: objectui’s 10 ADRs parse to zero decision units, so every objectui decision card is stuck on `Prior rulings read: unresolved`
body:
Path: none

`scripts/pm/check-prior-rulings.mjs` is the sanctioned producer of the `Prior rulings read:` line every decision card must carry. Run from an **objectui** checkout it refuses:

```text
check-prior-rulings: PREREQUISITE NOT MET — `docs/adr` parsed to zero decision units at origin/main.
  Nothing was searched. The paste line is:
    Prior rulings read: unresolved
  (Exit code 3)
```

Measured at 2026-09-18T22:12Z, `cwd` = `/home/user/objectui`, `--terms gate,required,spec,shape`.

## The control, in the same act

`docs/adr` is not missing and is not empty. On `objectui@origin/main` `8f37c4e90`:

```text
docs/adr/0001-master-detail-subform.md
docs/adr/0034-unified-runtime-metadata-persistence.md
docs/adr/0036-field-conditional-rules.md
docs/adr/0053-list-view-navigation-modes.md
docs/adr/0054-ui-testability-contract.md
docs/adr/0055-parameterized-bare-data-surface.md
docs/adr/0056-permission-editing-studio.md
docs/adr/0057-console-ai-chat-one-conversation-docked.md
docs/adr/0058-cascading-select-options.md
docs/adr/0059-action-params-shared-field-widgets.md
count: 10
```

⇒ ten ADR files in, zero decision units out. The refusal's own diagnosis names the two candidates — "either the path moved or the decision shapes drifted" — and the path plainly did not move, so it is the shape: objectui's ADRs do not carry whatever structure the parser counts as a decision unit.

## Why it matters rather than being cosmetic

The tool is honest about its own failure, which is the good half: it refuses rather than printing `none`, and it says in as many words why `none` would be a lie. The cost is that **no objectui decision card can ever cite a prior ruling**. Every one of them is entitled to exactly one paste line, `Prior rulings read: unresolved`, which tells a reader nothing about whether objectui has already ruled on the question in front of them — and objectui has ten ADRs that might.

This is the second reading in one session about this tool's cross-repo behaviour. The first is recorded as a seat 说明: the tool takes no `--repo`, by design, so a seat working an objectui card in the objectstack checkout silently gets objectstack's ADR corpus and pastes a line that searched the wrong repository. Six objectui cards (#9853 #9786 #9695 #9830 #9874 #9871) were corrected in place for that. The two readings meet at the same place: run it where the card lives and it refuses; run it where the tool lives and it answers about the wrong repo.

## Shape of the fix (not a ruling)

Either the parser learns objectui's ADR shape, or the refusal gains a sentence naming which repo's `docs/adr` it just read so the wrong-corpus case is visible too. Which of those — or both — is the lane's call.

## Dedup words

`check-prior-rulings`, `Prior rulings read`, `zero decision units`, `docs/adr objectui`, `PREREQUISITE NOT MET`
